blocks.h: How generative engine optimization gets you cited
paras: Buyers now ask AI assistants which product, supplier or provider to choose. If your brand is not in the answer, you are not in the shortlist. Generative engine optimization, or GEO, is the work of making your pages, products and expertise easy for AI tools to find, trust and quote.

We start with an AI visibility audit. We run the questions your buyers ask across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Gemini, record where you are cited, where competitors are cited instead and which pages AI tools rely on. That gives you a clear share-of-voice baseline.

Then we fix the causes. Structured data and product feeds that AI tools can read. FAQ and comparison content written in the plain format answer engines quote. Clean catalog attributes so your products match specific questions. Strong technical SEO so the right pages are crawled at all.

GEO sits on top of good SEO, not instead of it. Our answer engine optimization work is tracked monthly, so you can see citations, mentions and AI referral traffic grow over time. Cited first, then clicked, then chosen.
